‼️‼️🆕 **[VACANCY] Senior Software Engineer (AI Infrastructure)**

**About the Role:**
We are looking for Senior Software Engineers to design, build, and scale the infrastructure powering cutting-edge AI products. This is a fully remote, flexible hourly contract role where you can set your own schedule.

**Details:**
• **Type:** Hourly Contract
• **Commitment:** 20–40 hours/week
• **Rate:** $60 - $100 / hr
• **Location:** Fully Remote (Worldwide)

**Who You Are:**
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
• Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, or similar
• Experience building backend services, APIs, or data-intensive applications
• Strong written communication skills for an async-first environment
• Must pass an online skills assessment test to qualify

**Contact for info and application link:** PM me directly on Telegram @alinataschina ‼️‼️
